statement: An AI incident with >= USD 1bn damage or >= 100 deaths is officially attributed to AI (OECD AIM; government statements; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2024. The largest officially reported single AI-enabled loss was a deepfake video-call fraud of ~USD 25 m against a multinational's regional office. Media investigations alleged AI decision-support systems were used to generate military targets at large scale in an armed conflict, but the military denied that the AI made targeting decisions; no official attribution of deaths to AI. A wrongful-death lawsuit over a companion chatbot (one death) was an allegation. The year's costliest IT outage (multi-billion losses) was a faulty software update, not AI. An interim international scientific report found no incident at this scale.

items.summary: Police in a major financial centre disclosed that an employee of a multinational firm paid out ~USD 25 m after a video call in which the CFO and colleagues were deepfakes; the firm confirmed in May. Largest publicly reported deepfake fraud of the year, ~40x below the USD 1 bn threshold.
items.detail: Bloc 30 Police briefing 2024-02-04 (HK$200 m); victim later confirmed as Arup (May 2024). Not re-extracted this run.

items.summary: Investigative reporting alleged that a military used an AI system to mark tens of thousands of people as targets in an armed conflict with minimal human review. The military stated the system was a database for cross-referencing intelligence, not an AI that identifies targets. Allegation, not an official attribution of deaths to AI.
items.detail: +972 Magazine / Local Call, 'Lavender: The AI machine directing Bloc 31's bombing spree in Gaza', 2024-04-03; IDF response published by The Guardian 2024-04-03. Not re-extracted this run.

items.summary: Interim government-backed international scientific report on advanced-AI safety catalogued current harms (fraud, non-consensual imagery, bias, reliability failures) and potential large-scale risks; it did not identify any incident of USD 1 bn damage or 100 deaths attributed to AI.
items.detail: International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI: Interim Report (chair Y. Bengio), published by Bloc G DSIT 2024-05-17 ahead of the Bloc H AI Summit.

items.summary: A wrongful-death lawsuit alleged a companion-chatbot service contributed to a teenager's suicide: first prominent case of its kind. One death; allegation in litigation, not an official attribution.
items.detail: Garcia v. Character Technologies et al., Bloc A District Court M.D. Florida, filed 2024-10-22. Not re-extracted this run.

items.summary: No 2024 incident met either threshold with official AI attribution. The year's largest IT incident (a faulty security-software update, est. multi-billion insured/uninsured losses) was not AI-related and is a reference point for scale only.
items.detail: CrowdStrike outage 2024-07-19 (Parametrix est. ~USD 5.4 bn losses to Fortune 500, 2024-07-24) - not AI. OECD AIM monitor not systematically queried this run.
